notes.measured_on: 2026-09-22; homelab@10.1.2.40 (GNOME 50.1, g-r-d 50.2, Ryzen 5 3400GE + Vega 11) from a macOS 27 M4 Pro that was also building other work; anim.py full-screen, headless mode

exceptions.fps_2560x1600: Host-bound, not client-bound: at 2560x1600 the reference host delivers about 96 Mpixel/s, 57 % more than the 61 Mpixel/s it delivers at 1280x800, while Drift's unacknowledged-frame queue stays at 0 every second and decode+present stays at 1.4-2.4 ms p95 (hundreds of frames per second of headroom). The ceiling is the Vega 11 capture-and-encode path on the GNOME host. See docs/adr/M9-1-performance-bench.md.
